rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The Google OAuth button was calling a non-existent backend endpoint. The original code tried to redirect to `${BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/google/login` which was never implemented in the backend.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed the redirect URL in handleGoogleLogin() to use Emergent Auth directly: `https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(redirectUrl)}`
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Confirmed the button now redirects to auth.emergentagent.com which shows the Google OAuth login page
